prompt: Build a landing page for Loop, a project management tool for small remote teams. I want a hero with a headline and signup button, a features section, a testimonials row, a pricing teaser and a footer. Make it feel friendly and trustworthy.
Create a pricing page for an API analytics product called Meterly with three tiers (Free, Team, Enterprise), a monthly/yearly toggle, a feature comparison table and a short FAQ.
Design an admin dashboard for an online store: a sidebar, a top bar with search, four KPI cards, a revenue chart placeholder, a recent orders table and a low-stock alerts list.
Make a portfolio site homepage for a freelance photographer named Maren Holt. Intro, a grid of six selected projects with titles and years, a short about section, and a contact section.
I need a one-page website for Osteria Lume, a small Italian restaurant. Hero, about the chef, a menu with starters, mains and desserts with prices, opening hours, and a reservation call to action.

Build the home page of the documentation site for an open source CLI called Forge. Include a search box, a getting started section with an install command, cards for the main guides, an API reference list and a changelog snippet.
Create a blog homepage for a newsletter about urban planning called The Long Block. A featured article, a list of recent posts with date, author and reading time, a topics list and a subscribe form.
Build a landing page for a two-day design conference called OFFSET in Rotterdam. Dates and venue, a speaker lineup, a schedule for both days, ticket options and a sponsors row.
Make a page for an indie band's new album release. Album cover placeholder, title, a tracklist with durations, tour dates with ticket links, and a mailing list signup.

Design a marketing page for Tally, a personal finance app. Hero with a phone mockup placeholder, three feature blocks (budgets, goals, shared accounts), security reassurance, app store buttons and a footer.
